title: Grizzly Helicopters Ltd

services.name: Heli Tours
services.desc: Grizzly Helicopters operates a fleet of two Astar 350 B2 helicopters based in Campbell River and Port McNeill on north central Vancouver Island. These helicopters are known for their fast, quiet ride while providing a high level of passenger comfort. Astars are also one of the few helicopters capable of maintaining performance from sea level to the top of the coastal mountain range while providing exceptional visibility from all seats. At Grizzly Helicopters we offer a full slate of helicopter charter services for commercial and government clients. Based in Campbell River and Port McNeill our experienced pilots and fleet of helicopters are standing by to provide transportation and support
